title: The work between games
lede: Screen it, program it, eat for it. This is the loop the games are the proof of.

mirror.title: The Mirror
mirror.line: A squat coach and a movement screen on your own camera. It cues what it can see, and every number it shows is an estimate.

quickScreen.title: Quick Screen
quickScreen.line: A free movement check on this camera: your jump in about a minute, or the full screen in about five. Nothing is sent.

readiness.title: Readiness check
readiness.line: Three jumps a day against your own normal: ready, normal or low. A low day eases your coached session and your coach is told. 18 and over.

drills.title: Drills
drills.line: The Playbook's wake-up and jump-and-land drills, on your camera. Follow the targets; nothing is sent.

programming.title: Your programming
programming.lineNone: No coach yet — an invite link puts their programming here.

library.title: Exercise library
library.line: Search every exercise by name, muscle or goal, or ask in plain words. Cues and faults on every one.

iron.title: Iron Paradise
iron.line: The gym floor. Lift, jump, and put a number on it.

playbook.title: The Playbook
playbook.line: Ten chapters on how the body actually moves, from the book. Every drill is one you can run tonight.

fuel.title: Fuel
fuel.line: Meals keyed to the numbers you enter, and the kitchens behind it.

squads.title: Squads and teams
squads.line: Train with friends: a group streak on the daily drill, a weekly league, reactions. No messages.

roster.title: Your roster
roster.line: The athletes you coach, what they have done this fortnight, and who is drifting.

combine.title: Combine day
combine.line: Run a tryout: jump, agility, sprint and a skill drill, station by station, then a ranked report.

combines.title: Your combines
combines.line: Your numbers from your coach’s combines, and where you placed.

standing.title: Where you stand
standing.line: PRQ, your grade, and what has moved since the last screen.

sprint.title: Sprint speed
sprint.line: Your phone on the finish line times the sprint; side-on it reads your top speed. Camera estimates, each with its ±. 18 and over.

velocity.title: Bar speed
velocity.line: Rep speed from your camera: zones, speed loss, your load-velocity line. Estimates, not lab numbers.
